repeatRuns.policy: The provider_chaos suite ran three consecutive times inside the acceptance script and three more times in the repeat loop (six runs total; all 16 tests passed in every run). The other flaky-sensitive integration suites and the focused workflow/quality/trace/reviewer/Gate filters then ran three consecutive times each. No retry was used to turn a failure green.
